criteria.use_existing: he says a skill, recipe, login or tool for this already exists, or that the assistant skipped it
criteria.dont_ask: he says the assistant should have acted instead of asking him, or done it itself
criteria.simpler: he asks for a simpler, plainer or more human explanation
criteria.reply_language: he complains the assistant answered in a language other than the one he wrote in
criteria.purple_line: he says the spoken purple line or its audio is missing, or humour went outside it
criteria.keep_going: he says the assistant stopped too early, got stuck, or must continue
criteria.none: none of these: a new request, a fact, or a correction of another kind

questions.instructions: Read the owner's message to his assistant. Which of these does it say about the assistant's last answer?
questions.purpose: Labels a correction the rules could not place, so each repeated rule the owner gives is counted as j.correction.
questions.retirement: Retire when the rules in src/correction-capture.ts place at least as many of the owner's corrections as Jev does, on the same prompts.
questions.name: Which correction
